skill.name: pdf-official
skill.description: Comprehensive PDF toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating and editing PDFs, merging or splitting documents, converting pages to images, and filling PDF forms.
skill.summary: Process PDFs, extract content, create documents, and fill forms with guided helper scripts.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, JavaScript template literals, comments, or documentation examples. The confirmed risk is limited to helper scripts that write caller-selected output files for JSON or completed PDFs. No evidence found for prompt injection, credential access, network exfiltration, or malicious command execution.

remediation.issue: Helper scripts write to caller-supplied output paths.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and parent directory traversal, and require confirmation before overwriting an existing file.

remediation.issue: Generated outputs are mixed with caller-controlled file names.
remediation.suggestion: Default all generated files to a dedicated output directory and print the resolved destination before writing.

remediation.issue: PDF examples rely on optional external tools and libraries.
remediation.suggestion: Add dependency checks and clear failure messages before running qpdf, poppler utilities, or PDF helper scripts.

content.value_statement: Teams often need reliable PDF extraction, conversion, and form filling without rebuilding workflows from scratch. This skill provides guided PDF operations, helper scripts, and reference examples for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Extract text, metadata, and tables from PDF files using Python libraries.
Create, merge, split, rotate, watermark, encrypt, and repair PDF documents.
Convert PDF pages to images for visual review and field mapping.
Detect fillable form fields and export field metadata for review.
Fill AcroForm fields after validating field identifiers, pages, and values.
Add text annotations to non-fillable PDFs using validated bounding boxes.
limitations: Requires local Python packages and some command-line PDF tools to be installed.
OCR workflows require extra dependencies and may need manual quality review.
Generated output paths can overwrite files if the caller chooses unsafe names.
PDF viewer differences can affect form appearance and annotation rendering.

use_cases.title: Complete Administrative Forms
use_cases.description: Map user answers to fillable or non-fillable PDF forms and produce a completed document.

use_cases.title: Extract Structured Content
use_cases.description: Pull text, tables, metadata, and page images from PDFs for review or downstream analysis.

use_cases.title: Prepare Document Packages
use_cases.description: Merge, split, rotate, watermark, encrypt, or repair PDF files for organized delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Extract PDF Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner text extraction from a single PDF.
prompt_templates.prompt: Extract the text from [file name]. Summarize each page and note any tables that may need separate extraction.

prompt_templates.title: Merge PDF Files
prompt_templates.scenario: Combine several documents into one deliverable.
prompt_templates.prompt: Merge [PDF list] into one file named [output name]. Preserve the page order and report any file that cannot be read.

prompt_templates.title: Fill a PDF Form
prompt_templates.scenario: Complete a form using supplied answers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether [form PDF] has fillable fields. If it does, extract the field list, map each field to the supplied answers, and create a completed PDF.

prompt_templates.title: Annotate a Non-Fillable Form
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for scanned or static forms.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert [PDF] to page images, identify non-fillable form regions, validate bounding boxes, and add text annotations using [answers]. Return a short validation summary.

output_examples.input: A three-page report needs text extraction and table review.
output_examples.output: Page text is summarized, tables are identified, and any low-confidence extraction areas are called out for review.

output_examples.input: A benefits form must be completed from supplied employee details.
output_examples.output: The form fields are mapped to the answers, values are validated, and a completed PDF is generated.

output_examples.input: Several signed PDFs must become one organized package.
output_examples.output: The files are merged in the requested order, page counts are reported, and the output document is named clearly.

best_practices: Run helper scripts only on PDFs and answers supplied by the user.
Use a dedicated output directory and review file names before writing results.
Open generated PDFs in a viewer to confirm layout, fields, and annotations.
anti_patterns: Do not run examples against unknown files without user approval.
Do not reuse field mappings across different PDF versions without revalidation.
Do not assume scanned PDFs support text extraction without OCR checks.

faq.question: Can this skill fill PDF forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect fillable fields and fill them after values are mapped and validated.

faq.question: Can it handle non-fillable forms?
faq.answer: Yes. It can convert pages to images, map regions, validate bounding boxes, and add text annotations.

faq.question: Does it perform OCR automatically?
faq.answer: No. OCR examples are provided, but extra dependencies and manual review are usually required.

faq.question: What tools does it use?
faq.answer: It references Python PDF libraries and common command-line tools such as qpdf and poppler utilities.

faq.question: Can it overwrite local files?
faq.answer: Yes. Some helper scripts write output files, so callers should choose output paths carefully.

faq.question: Is it suitable for sensitive documents?
faq.answer: It processes local files, but users should review dependencies, output paths, and document handling policies first.
